title: Android Application Developer
description:
**Android App Developer**

* Design, develop, and maintain Android applications.
* Write clean, efficient, and scalable code using Kotlin or Java.
* Integrate APIs, databases, and third-party services.
* Test and debug applications to ensure smooth performance.
* Collaborate with the design and development team to improve app functionality and user experience.
* Maintain and update existing applications as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Android Development (Java/Kotlin)
* React Native or Flutter
* Firebase & API Integration
* Database Handling
* Real-Time Dashboard Development
* Graphs, Reports & Analytics
* Google Maps Integration
* AWS / Cloud Services

**Preferred:**

* IoT & ESP32 Device Integration
* MQTT Protocol
* Play Store Deployment Experience

**What You'll Work On:**

* Air Quality Monitoring Apps
* Industrial IoT Dashboards
* Device Monitoring & Control Applications
* Real-Time Data Visualization Systems

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Application development: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person
